cited_by.title: Bush teas and herbal remedies (cerasee, bitter leaf) with medicines

record.population: Diabetic rodents and cell and tissue models (preclinical review)
record.design: Narrative review of preclinical studies of Vernonia amygdalina (bitter leaf) in diabetes
record.finding: The review calls bitter leaf potently antidiabetic in preclinical work and appraises the evidence for future research. All the studies discussed are in animals and cells.
record.note: Preclinical only. My PubMed search for bitter leaf and diabetes in humans returned no human trial. It says nothing about safe amounts or interactions in people.
